overview: Savanna Borderlands is the bright grassland frontier between Shar Vahl and Shadeweaver’s Thicket. Patrols, scouts, and wildlife define this transitional zone.
history: Vah Shir hunters established patrol routes to protect Shar Vahl.
Seru scouts attempted to map the savanna but met resistance.
Grimling scouts began probing the borderlands from the thicket.
Corrupted wildlife emerged from deeper forest shadows.
The savanna became a contested scouting zone.
hooks: A Vah Shir patrol reports Grimling scouts near the thicket edge.
A corrupted beast wanders out of the inner forest.
Seru scouts attempt to establish a new mapping post.
Shadow corruption spreads into the tall grass.
